name: Motogi Gin
source:
Also known as Basil P, the producer behind internet idol Komeko (コメコ). He is an artist who is well-versed in music and also provides songs to other artists. He is an optimist with a generous spirit, but he can also be pushy and over confident. He has synesthesia that allows him to hear sounds through touch.

[Translated from in-game profile]
